# delete_llm_directory_tool

> Delete EMPTY directories from the LLM file system.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | `data` |
| Callable | MCP clients; in-app @ai conversations (default); grantable to agents |
| Filter | `https://www.dsiloed.com/api/v1/mcp?tools=delete_llm_directory_tool` |

## Description

This is the description the server sends to the model, verbatim.

Delete EMPTY directories from the LLM file system. Removes the named folders and any
empty subfolders beneath them.

SAFETY: a directory is refused (and left untouched) when ANY file exists anywhere in its
subtree, including files you can't see. This tool never deletes files — move them with
move_llm_file_tool (or archive them under /archive) first, then delete the empty folder.
The root directory "/" cannot be deleted.

TYPICAL USE: after consolidating a folder's files into another folder, the old folder is
left as an empty stub. Pass all the stubs in one call:
{directory_paths: ["/marketing", "/Technical Plans", "/tmp-verify"]}

Each path is reported individually as deleted, not_found, not_empty (with the file count)
or access_denied, so a refused path never blocks the others.

CROSS-TENANT: OWN-TENANT ONLY. A directory shared from another tenant cannot be deleted.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `directory_paths` | array of string | yes | Directory paths to delete (each must contain no files). Example: ["/marketing", "/tmp-verify"]. |
